packages.title: Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, Live TV, Trakt, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Account switching: Trakt activity, profiles and upcoming episode dismissals stay with your account.
Playback preferences: Subtitle requests follow the current title. Forced subtitles and per-show audio choices work across more sources.
Discover and search: Browse longer catalogs and see available search results while slower sources respond.
Film collections: Collection pages recover from delayed title lookups and finish loading when a source is unavailable.
